definitions.gloss: immature; unripe; not fully developed; not yet mature
definitions.explanation: The state of not having reached full maturity or development. Used for both physical immaturity (fruit, organisms) and abstract immaturity (skills, systems, markets, personality).

examples.japanese: {未成熟|みせいじゅく}な⟦{果実|かじつ}→果実：00146_kajitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酸|す}っぱい。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未成熟|みせいじゅく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{伸|の}びしろ→伸びしろ：14898_nobishiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This market is still immature and has room for growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}くて→若い：00823_wakai⟧{未成熟|みせいじゅく}な{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned a lot from the mistakes I made in my young, immature days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未成熟|みせいじゅく}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{将来性|しょうらいせい}→将来性：22412_shouraisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The technology is still immature, but it is rated as having high potential.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + ⟦{成熟|せいじゅく}→成熟：12638_seijuku⟧ (maturity, ripeness). The prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ indicates that the state has not yet been reached, implying it may be reached in the future. This is different from {不|ふ}, which negates more absolutely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未成熟|みせいじゅく}な⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: an immature market
- {未成熟|みせいじゅく}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: immature technology
- {未成熟|みせいじゅく}な⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: an immature stage
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{未成熟|みせいじゅく}: emotionally immature

RELATED PATTERNS:
⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧～ as a prefix meaning 'not yet':
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete, unfinished
- ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced
- ⟦{未確認|みかくにん}→未確認：22493_mikakunin⟧: unconfirmed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成熟|せいじゅく}→成熟：12638_seijuku⟧: mature, ripe — the opposite; having reached full development
- ⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧: immature, unskilled — more common in everyday use; often implies lack of skill
- ⟦{幼稚|ようち}→幼稚：04088_youchi⟧: childish, infantile — more negative; implies thinking or behavior is inappropriately childlike
